Officially announces his intention to run in the 2008 presidential election, in Dearborn, Michigan.
- Suspends his campaign after a disappointing showing in the Super Tuesday primaries and caucuses.
In a YouTube video, Romney announces that he's formed an exploratory committee in his second run for the White House.
Romney officially announces his candidacy for president, from a family farm in Stratham, New Hampshire.
Romney's campaign releases tax documents showing Romney made $42.7 million over the past two years and paid $6.2 million in taxes.
- Announces Wisconsin Congressman Paul Ryan as his running mate.
Gives his acceptance speech at the Republican National Convention in Tampa, Florida.
The documents show Romney made $13.7 million and paid $1.94 million in taxes, a tax rate of 14.1%.
- Defeated in the general election by President Barack Obama.
Romney wins 206 Electoral College votes to Obama's 332.
